free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0 a month: 2,500 api requests daily for forward and reverse geocoding; the daily limit refreshes at midnight UTC, and sign-up needs no credit card
free_tier.notes: no hard limit is set: responses are throttled if requests are more than 30% of the allowed quota daily

per_object_cap.stated: one query a request: the q parameter takes up to 50 characters; no batch endpoint is documented

retention.stated: the service does not store query requests

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in requests, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS GET to geokeo.com/geocode/v1/search.php (q and api parameters) for forward and /geocode/v1/reverse.php (lat, lng and api) for reverse geocoding, JSON or XML; a keyless call answered HTTP 200 with the JSON status INVALID_REQUEST, so the status field carries the error, not the HTTP code
chaining: 2,500 storable forward or reverse geocodes a day on a name, email and password account with no card, built from OpenStreetMap, GeoNames and Natural Earth data; one query per request, so bulk work is sent as many single requests

limits.value: 2,500 api requests a day on the Free plan, refreshed at midnight UTC
no hard limit is set; responses are throttled if requests are more than 30% of allowed quota daily
the q parameter is limited to 50 characters, one query a request

binding_note: no per-second limit is published, so the stated 2,500-request day is the ceiling that is met first

identity_cost.detail: an account at geokeo.com/signup.php with a name, an email address, a password and a CAPTCHA; the home page says to sign up without any credit card; the service stores the email address, billing address and name

reliability_note: a request over the allowance is throttled rather than refused; an application error such as INVALID_REQUEST comes back with HTTP 200, so the JSON status field must be read
confidence_note: the pricing page, the documentation, the sign-up page and the home page were quoted on 2026-11-02; a keyless call answered HTTP 200 with the JSON status INVALID_REQUEST. No account was opened, so the free daily allowance was not exercised.
